poses.caption: Hold a forearm side bridge with feet stacked, elbow below shoulder and hips lifted in line with the body.
Reach the top arm under the torso with a small controlled twist while keeping the hips raised, then return. Finish repetitions before switching sides.

jobs.prompt: Correct original male TWIST SIDE BRIDGE two panels. Preserve lower forearm/elbow under shoulder fixed mat, straight legs and same STACKED feet, pelvis raised with visible gap both poses, no support switch. LEFT top arm vertical. RIGHT top arm threads UNDER TORSO: hand passes through open space BELOW ribs ABOVE mat and emerges just BEYOND far side of torso, palm visible. Upper chest rotates gently downward20degrees while hips stay high, not just arm in front, no prone plank/rolling. Remove ALL red sixpack/fiber/rays from shirt. Replace ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED abdominal teaching tint over continuous opaque BLACK shirt, broad cloth folds only, no anatomy drawn under fabric. Full opaque shorts FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH, fine exposed grayscale anatomy. Two equal square cells WIDE LANDSCAPE, same body scale, generous head/hand/shoe margins, white background no text.
